scripture.text: The Lord came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain; and the Lord called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up. Then the Lord spoke to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, so that they do not break through to the Lord to gaze, and many of them perish. Also let the priests who come near to the Lord consecrate themselves, or else the Lord will break out against them.” Moses said to the Lord, “The people cannot come up to Mount Sinai, for You warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds about the mountain and consecrate it.’ ” Then the Lord said to him, “Go down and come up again, you and Aaron with you; but do not let the priests and the people break through to come up to the Lord, or He will break forth upon them.” So Moses went down to the people and told them.

Teach us to remember that Exodus 20:22-26 opens with a scene marked by commandment-shaped obedience under holy authority. Guard our speech from haste, our work from pride, and our choices from whatever would pull us away from commandment-shaped obedience instead of selective morality. Help us practice the obedience this day requires with humility as we pursue concrete obedience shaped by God's holy commands. Amen.
